exposure: Combinations of fetal sex in twin gestations (male-male, female-female, male-female)
cohort: The study included 1073 twin gestations, categorized by the sex of the twins (male-male, female-female, male-female) and their intrauterine position.
finding: Twin gestations with a first twin male tend to have worse neonatal outcomes, and the presence of a male co-twin increases the risk of adverse neonatal outcomes, including NICU admission.
